summary:
Look review of A3 M4 (the tactical battle drawer) on feature/abilities at 04383d08. The task gave the SHA as 04383d082e1b72f5…, which does not resolve; the 8-character prefix matches origin/feature/abilities (04383d08752e…, the round r2 fix commit), so I reviewed that. I changed no tracked files.

Verdict: OK. There is no blocker, high or medium finding. I found 5 low ones.

Display only: the sim id is still c22b2587f4b7 and COOP_PROTOCOL is still 8.

What I checked, at 844x390, 667x375, 915x412, 1024x768 and 1280x720:
- The girl drawer for Kage 3-2-0, Chika 3-2-0, Sango 0-3-2, Miko 3-0-0 (a support), Momo, and Aoi 2-3-0 (a locked third path).
- The hero drawer (Hikari LV 7), the ally drawer, and Sell CONFIRM.
- The armed buy state (tap 1), including tap 1 on a price she cannot pay.
- The ability bar between waves, ready, and cooling (11s and 36s), with the drawer closed and open.
- The lock "i" toasts and a long tip toast.
- 3x crops of corners and edges.
- A probe of all 30 girls' path rows and ability names at 844 and 1280.

All the measurements below are from my own runs.
- Drawer width: 288 px on every phone size (the limit is 300) and 340 px at 1024 and 1280.
- Numbers: at most 13 in any drawer, and 14 only while an ability cools (13 + 1 is allowed).
- Text size: the smallest drawer text is 12 px on phones and 13 px at 1024 and 1280.
- Cutting: no text is cut by an ellipsis and no price is cut, on any still.
- Type sizes: 12/13/16/22 px at 844 and 915, and 12/13/16 px at 667.
- Contrast: every visible drawer text is at least 4.5:1 on its real composited background (lowest median 5.0). The only failures were lock "i" glyphs scrolled out of view below the fold.
- The ability bar ends 10 to 12 px left of the drawer and its slots are 44x44. The hero widget and the bar never overlap.
- Toasts: 12 px on phones, one line beside the drawer. The long tip wraps to two lines and is never cut.
- The ally's path rows are not tap targets.
- The look matches the Oct 14 mock: navy ink plate with one chamfer, target chips, caps-over-number stat row, coloured path edges with pips, yellow price buttons (lock-coin and dim when she is poor), a one-line lock reason, Invested and Sell +N.

Every earlier finding I can check is fixed, except where noted.

Round r0:
- logic-1 (Space on a row): fixed. m4-key-space shows the wave stays in prep.
- logic-2 (gear Pierce): fixed. gearPierce only counts kits that pierce.
- look-1 (667 bottom sheet): fixed. 667 now gets the 288 px side drawer with all three rows in view.
- look-2 (Chika 3-2-0 third row at 844): fixed. "Later update" stays on one line and every row is in view at 844, 667 and 915.
- look-3 (Sango 0-3-2 at 844): fixed on phones. Tidebreaker Shell is not cut when closed or opened (160 px box, scrollWidth equals clientWidth). Wide Fragmentation is one line at 844, 667 and 915. It still wraps on the wide drawer: see look-r2-1 (low).
- logic-3 (over 13 numbers): fixed.
- look-4 (low): fixed. MORE is an ink chip, RANGE reads 3.0 in Details too, and the hero's ally note uses the short text on phones.

Round r1 look:
- look-r1-1 (toasts): fixed. Phone toasts are 12 px, the lock reasons are one line and uncut, and the tip wraps.
- look-r1-2 (overflow chip): fixed. The "⋯" chip is 40 px wide with a tap area of at least 40x40 and the label "More targets: Priority, Air". LAST is at least 40 px.
- look-r1-3 (cut prices): fixed. A card cut by the strip's edge is faded, its price is hidden, and a › cue shows. No price was cut on any still at 844, 667, 915 or 1024.
- look-r1-4 (low, small taps): partly fixed. Tree, Close, Sell, MORE, FIRE, her name and the "i" are now 38 to 40 px, and every hero drawer control is at least 39 px. Some rows are still small: see look-r2-3.
- look-r1-5 (13 numbers with HUD): the reading in use is now written into UI_DIRECTION M2 and marked for the owner's ruling.
- look-r1-6 (off-scale type sizes): fixed.
- look-r1-7 (1280 wraps): fixed. All 30 ability names are one line at 1280, and the held tier's rule is one line ("Tier V: one Sango at a time").
- look-r1-8 (WAVE label contrast): fixed. The label is on an ink plate and measures 15.7:1.

Round r1 logic:
- logic-r1-1 (stat row goes stale): fixed. In m4-stat-live, DMG goes from 11.4 to 12.6 with no re-render.
- logic-r1-2 (ability name cut when opened): fixed.
- logic-r1-4 (focus lost): fixed. m4-keys shows the focus moves to PRIORITY and then to MAX, and Space starts nothing.
- logic-r1-5 (Sell and Buy armed together): fixed. A price tap disarms Sell's CONFIRM.
- logic-r1-6 (ally rows act as buttons): fixed.

One thing outside M4: the whole-screen probe still finds 8.96 px HUD text (look-r2-5, for M5).

Harness notes:
- This 4-CPU box ran at a load of 30 to 50, so several full m4 runs died partway; I re-ran their scenes in smaller sets.
- On this box the 2.6 s Sell CONFIRM window ends before a screenshot finishes. For the CONFIRM still I stubbed the timer in my page only, not in the repo.

Evidence is under /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/bc8e90b4-5af0-5aad-ab54-4a98bb73399f/scratchpad/abil-m4/r2look-b/:
- x<WxH>/: my probe stills with their extra-<WxH>.json data.
- q<WxH>/: the toast, Sell CONFIRM, hero and cooling stills.
- <WxH>/: the repo's m4 scenes.
- names1280/ and names844/: all 30 girls' path rows.
- hero/: hero drawer tap areas.
- crops/: the 3x zooms.
- tools/: my scripts.

Cleanup: I removed my worktree /home/user/wt-abil-rev-look-2 and stopped my dev server on 5202. No dist was built. My scratch files take 89 MB.

Disk: / has only 1.3 GB free, which is below the 1.5 GB floor. Most of that space is used by other running workflows, not by this review.

findings.title: Wide drawer (1024 and 1280): Sango's "Wide Fragmentation" wraps to two lines and its ⚡ sits alone on a third line
findings.detail:
The round r1 fix for r0 look-3 (fitPaths: the pips move to the tier line, then the open row's ⚡ folds, then the name takes the smaller size) only runs on phones. At 1024x768 and 1280x720 the drawer is 340 px wide, but the path name shares its line with the ⚡ chip and the pips, so "Wide Fragmentation" (19 px) breaks after "Wide" and the ⚡ drops to a line of its own.

Her row is 77 px tall closed and 98 px from T3 up. Every other row is 60 to 65 px.

At 1024x768 with that row open (tap 1: the tier sentence takes three lines), Concentrated Siege's lock line slides under the fold. The scroll cue's ▾ then lands on its text ("ca▾n pass T2").

This is not cut and it stays readable, so it is low, like r1's look-r1-7 for 1280 wraps. It is still the one girl whose row looks unlike the mock on PC.

Fix: run the same name-line fit on the wide drawer (pips to the tier line first; there is room for "Wide Fragmentation ⚡" on one line once the pips move), or keep the ⚡ inline after the name with nowrap. Add Sango 0-3-2 to the 1280 m4-drawer-fit scene and assert one name line.

My names probe (tools/names.mjs) placed each of the 30 girls at 0-0-0 and with her ⚡ path at T3.

- At 844 all 30 girls are one line with 35 to 36 px rows (names844/names-844x390.json).
- extra-1024x768: d-sango, d-sango-armed and d-sango-wave-cooling report WRAPS 'Wide Fragmentation' lines 2.

findings.title: The scroll cue's ▾ is drawn on top of text at the fold
findings.detail:
When content sits below the fold, the white ▾ cue is centred over the last visible line, with no backing. It lands on glyphs:
- "ca▾n pass T2": Sango 0-3-2 armed at 1024x768.
- "Celestial Bloom▾unlocked": the hero's MORE level list at 1280x720.
- "Tesla Engi▾neering": Chika 3-2-0 armed at 667x375.

The text under it is already fading, so this is cosmetic. Still, a white glyph over text reads as clutter on the ink plate.

Fix: give the ▾ a small ink pill (--plate with a hairline), or move it into the scroll body's bottom padding so it never overlaps a line box.

findings.title: Phones: some dense-row tap targets are still under the 40 px minimum
findings.detail:
This carries over from look-r1-4, which r2 partly fixed. The two-tap buy guards the price and row taps, so it does not block.

Hit-tested from each control's centre outward at 844, 667 and 915. These are still under 40 px:
- Path row bodies: 32 to 34 px tall, and 29 px for the open row.
- Price buttons on rows where the next row paints over their lower hit area (Miko's and Momo's 3,400/120 and 3,500/120): 36 px.
- The Auto switch on an opened ability row: 35 px.
- Chika's Flight chips (HOVER, HOLD, PATROL): 26 px. They take a single tap with no guard and sit 2 px above the target chips. ABILITIES §17.7 does allow a 28 px row there.

Now at or near 40 px: Tree, Close, Sell and MORE (39 to 42 px), FIRE and her name (38 to 39 px), the lock "i" (38 to 40 px), "⋯" (40 px), and every hero drawer control (Level up 44 px, the ult 39 px, Move 40 px, MORE 42 px).

Suggestion for the next density pass: give the Flight chips' hit areas the same downward ::after the target chips have, and give the rows 40 px of pitch where the fold allows.

findings.title: At 667x375 the side drawer covers 39% of the board's central box (20% at 844)
findings.detail:
The central box is the middle 50% of the board between the HUD and the card strip. At 667 the 288 px drawer is 43% of the screen width.

Coverage of the central box:
- 667x375: 39% (129 px).
- 844x390: 20% (85 px).
- 915x412: 15%.
- 1024x768: 18%.

The board does not shift when the drawer opens. P1 still holds (at least 50% of the screen stays visible), and the spec prescribes this drawer, so this is information rather than a defect.

Fix, if the owner wants the selected girl and the road centre kept clear on small phones: on 667-class screens, pan the board camera left by part of the drawer width while it is open.

findings.title: Outside M4: 8.96 px HUD text is still on screen beside every drawer (the "New!" sticker and the HERO card tag)
findings.detail:
On every viewport, uiProbe's whole-screen smallest text is 8.96 px. It is the "New!" sticker on the next-wave chip, or the "HERO" tag on the hero card, both under the 12 px floor.

M4's diff does not touch either rule, and the HUD and card strip are M5's work, so this does not block M4. I record it so M5 picks it up.
